name: Pristine Crawler Leg
summary: Pristine Crawler Legs come from the spiny rock crawlers around Theramore Isle. Morgan Stern needs them for the presentation of a new dish he is researching.

sections.title: A Chef’s Request
sections.body: Morgan Stern is researching a dish in Theramore Isle, and pristine crawler legs are one of its ingredients. He wants the shells unscarred, since their condition matters to the dish’s presentation. Spiny Rock Crabs prowl the waters east of the isle, where you can find the legs he needs.

faq.q: What are Pristine Crawler Legs for?
faq.answer: Morgan Stern needs Pristine Crawler Legs as an ingredient for a new recipe he is researching in Theramore.

faq.q: Where can I find Pristine Crawler Legs?
faq.answer: Spiny Rock Crabs along the waters east of Theramore Isle have Pristine Crawler Legs.

faq.q: Why do the legs need to be pristine?
faq.answer: Morgan wants unscarred shells because they are key to the dish’s presentation.
Morgan Stern, a chef in Theramore, wants the legs for his recipe research.

angles.text: As a cook, you can see why Morgan cares about the shell as well as the meat: both are part of the dish he is researching.
